definitions.gloss: to give birth; to deliver a baby
definitions.explanation: To bear a child. Used for both humans and animals, though for animals 産む is more common.

examples.japanese: ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧{出産|しゅっさん}した。
examples.english: My older sister gave birth last month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出産|しゅっさん}する⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: My wife is due to give birth next spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧{出産|しゅっさん}するとき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧なこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think there are many things to worry about when giving birth for the first time.

notes:
A somewhat formal or medical-register word for giving birth. In casual conversation, ⟦{産|う}む→産む：01899_umu⟧ is more common. {出産|しゅっさん}する emphasizes the event of childbirth as a process.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{出産予定日|しゅっさんよていび}→出産予定日：30115_shussanyoteibi⟧: due date
- {出産費用|しゅっさんひよう}: childbirth expenses
- ⟦{出産祝|しゅっさんいわ}い→出産祝い：08660_shussaniwai⟧: baby shower gift; congratulatory gift for a birth
- {出産休暇|しゅっさんきゅうか}: maternity leave
- ⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出産|しゅっさん}する: to give birth safely

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{産|う}む→産む：01899_umu⟧: to give birth — more colloquial, also used for animals and figuratively for creating/producing
- ⟦{分娩|ぶんべん}→分娩：22801_bunben⟧: delivery — medical term used by doctors and in hospitals
